function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Using only the benchmark's returned evidence and source identifiers, reconstruct the publicly documented OneCoin/Cryptoqueen fraud scheme. Identify the principal founders and other materially documented participants, their roles, and supported relationships, but omit any identity, role, relationship, or conclusion not supported by the returned evidence. For every point, distinguish: (1) established enforcement or court facts; (2) allegations in indictments, complaints, or prosecutors' statements; (3) investigative or law-enforcement assessments; (4) disputed accounts or denials; and (5) unresolved claims. Pay special attention to Ruja Ignatova's current status, clearly separating what is documented from what remains unknown or alleged. Return a readable research dossier with precise source IDs from the benchmark for every assertion, preferably quoting or closely paraphrasing the evidence, and include an entity/relationship inventory. Do not use outside sources, infer beyond the evidence, or fabricate dates, places, identities, roles, relationships, or source IDs. The final user will need to produce a Markdown report and a fenced JSON object with exactly these arrays: findings, claims, reasoning_steps, contradictions. Please gather enough evidence to populate those structures: findings must have question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; claims must have claim and source_references; reasoning_steps must have id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; contradictions must have contradiction_id, description, source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
